subject: Geografia
description_pt: Caracterizar dinâmicas dos componentes físico-naturais no território nacional, bem como sua distribuição e biodiversidade (Florestas Tropicais, Cerrados, Caatingas, Campos Sulinos e Matas de Araucária).

components.description_pt: Caracterizar componentes físico-naturais dos principais biomas brasileiros
components.description_en: Characterize the physical-natural components of Brazil's major biomes

components.description_pt: Descrever a distribuição espacial de Florestas Tropicais, Cerrados, Caatingas, Campos Sulinos e Florestas de Araucária no território nacional
components.description_en: Describe the spatial distribution of Tropical Rainforests, Cerrados, Caatingas, Campos Sulinos, and Araucária Forests across the national territory
components.cc_component_description: Identify patterns in observational data to explain the distribution of organisms in an environment

components.description_pt: Explicar a biodiversidade associada a cada um dos principais biomas brasileiros
components.description_en: Explain the biodiversity associated with each of Brazil's major biomes
components.cc_component_description: Explain how biodiversity completeness serves as an indicator of ecosystem health

components.description_pt: Analisar a dinâmica de componentes físico-naturais no território nacional brasileiro
components.description_en: Analyze the dynamics of physical-natural components across the Brazilian national territory

cc_matches.description: Construct an explanation of observed relationships (e.g., the distribution of plants in the back yard).

Biodiversity describes the variety of species found in Earth’s terrestrial and oceanic ecosystems. The completeness or integrity of an ecosystem’s biodiversity is often used as a measure of its health.
